s001: Nothing moves in the empty corridor; the overhead light flickers faintly once. Camera: slow, steady handheld push-in down the corridor.
s002: The instruments lie perfectly still on the cloth while light glints softly along the steel. Camera: slow handheld drift sideways across the rows with a gentle push-in.
s003: The nurse lifts her eyes from the desk and holds a wary gaze, blinking once; her hands rest still. Camera: subtle handheld drift with a slow push-in.
s004: The vet slowly moves the stethoscope across the cat's side; the cat blinks, ears twitching, tail tip flicking. Background stays still. Camera: gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s005: The vet pauses, lifts his head and frowns thoughtfully, one hand resting on the cat; the cat slowly turns its head toward him. Mouth closed. Camera: slow handheld drift to the left.
s006: The cats trot forward along the road at a steady pace, tails up, following the man as he walks ahead. Camera: handheld, gently tracking with the moving cats.
s007: A few cats stroll slowly along the road while others sit, licking a paw or turning their heads; leaves stir lightly. Camera: gentle handheld drift with a slow push-in.
s008: The man holds the scroll still and looks from it up to the camera with a knowing half-smile, mouth closed. Camera: slow handheld push-in toward the scroll.
s009: The cats walk steadily along the sunny street, tails swaying, one pausing to glance sideways. Houses stay still. Camera: gentle handheld tracking alongside them.
s010: The woman slowly strokes the cat from head to tail, smiling softly, mouth closed; the cat blinks contentedly, an ear twitches, leaves sway behind. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s012: Traffic flows steadily along the street below and pedestrians walk past the shopfronts; signs stay still. Camera: steady handheld view with a slow pan to the right.
s013: Cats lounge lazily in the sun; one stretches, another flicks its tail, a third slowly turns its head. Camera: slow handheld push-in along the boardwalk.
s014: The hands hold the cat's mouth gently open and steady; the cat blinks slowly and its whiskers twitch, teeth staying clearly visible. Camera: slow, smooth handheld push-in on the teeth.
s015: The cat peers out, slowly turning its head and blinking at the lights; blurred buses and people pass behind. Camera: gentle handheld sway with a slight walking bob.
s016: The fingers hold the lip steady while the cat blinks and its whiskers twitch; tartar and gums stay clearly visible. Camera: slow handheld push-in on the teeth.
s017: The cat sits still watching the rain, tail tip slowly curling, ears twitching at the sound; raindrops run down the glass. Camera: gentle handheld drift with a slow push-in.
s018: The hand tilts the spoon and a fine stream of powder falls softly onto the food; the bowl stays still. Camera: steady handheld, slow push-in on the bowl.
s019: The calm water ripples past and the boat rocks gently while the island stays steady on the horizon. Camera: slight handheld bob with the boat, slow drift forward.
s020: Cats walk slowly along the path by the harbour wall, tails swaying; the water glints softly. Camera: gentle handheld drift following them.
s021: Cats wander unhurriedly along the lane, one stopping to sniff a plant; leaves stir in a light breeze. Camera: slow handheld push-in down the lane.
s023: Lisa slowly strokes Lily along her back, smiling softly with her mouth closed; Lily blinks and nudges her head into the hand. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s024: The nurse works carefully and slowly over the sleeping cat; its chest rises and falls gently, monitors flicker behind. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s025: The woman scrunches her face and leans back slightly, lips pressed shut, as the cat leans closer and breathes out, whiskers twitching. Camera: subtle handheld drift.
s026: The heart-rate line scrolls steadily across the screen and the numbers flicker; everything else stays still. Camera: slow, steady handheld push-in on the monitor.
s027: The vet keeps writing slowly, then pauses and lifts her eyes with a grave expression, mouth closed. Camera: slow handheld push-in.
s028: The woman glances up from her phone and gives a small, kind smile, mouth closed; the phone stays steady in her hand. Camera: gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s031: Cats lounge on the benches; one yawns, another flicks its tail, a third blinks sleepily. Trees stay still. Camera: slow handheld pan to the right.
s032: The cats shift around the bench, one stepping closer, others turning their heads and twitching their ears. Camera: gentle handheld drift with a slight push-in.
s033: The tabby walks steadily toward the camera, tail up; the cats behind sit and watch, tails swaying. Camera: handheld, slowly backing away at its pace.
s034: The hand shakes a fine, gentle stream of powder over the food from left to right; the bowl stays still. Camera: steady handheld, slow push-in.
s035: Everything stays still while soft daylight shifts gently across the powder and a few grains settle. Camera: slow, smooth handheld push-in toward the scoop.
s036: The dish and fruit stay perfectly still while leaf shadows drift slowly across the table. Camera: slow handheld drift to the right.
s037: Cats crowd in, tails swaying, heads turning toward the food as the people slowly hand out bits, mouths closed. Camera: gentle handheld drift with a slow push-in.
s038: Cats sit calmly; one turns its head toward the sea, another licks a paw, waves roll softly behind. Crates and nets stay still. Camera: subtle handheld drift to the left.
s039: People lean down and drop scraps while cats weave between the tables, tails up, a few nibbling; mouths stay closed. Camera: gentle handheld drift, slow pan right.
s040: The hands hold the lip steady as the tabby blinks slowly and its ear twitches; teeth and gums stay clearly visible. Camera: slow handheld push-in.
s042: The tabby walks steadily over the pebbles toward the camera, tail up and swaying; small waves wash in behind. Camera: handheld, slowly backing away at its pace.
s043: The scoop stays perfectly still; a few loose grains slide gently down the heap as the soft light shifts. Camera: slow, smooth push-in.
s044: The golden droplet slowly falls and lands on the tooth, spreading outward in a soft glowing ripple; the tooth stays still. Camera: smooth, slow push-in toward the impact.
s045: The golden film slowly melts and drips down off the teeth, revealing clean white enamel underneath. Camera: smooth, slow lateral track along the row of teeth.
s046: The woman gently rocks the cat and strokes its head, smiling with her mouth closed; the cat blinks slowly and twitches an ear. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slight push-in.
s047: The soft blue glow travels steadily from the stomach up the throat into the mouth, pulsing gently; the cat's body stays still. Camera: smooth, slow tilt up following the glow.
s048: The tiny bacteria busily hammer and stack plaque with bouncy cartoon motion; the cat holds its mouth wide and blinks. Camera: smooth, slow push-in toward the teeth.
s049: A glowing golden wave rushes across the tooth from left to right, tumbling the tiny bacteria away; the tooth stays still and gleams. Camera: smooth, slow pull-back.
s050: The vet gently cradles and strokes the cat, smiling with her mouth closed; the cat blinks and slowly turns its head. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s051: The shelves and bags stay completely still. Camera: slow handheld walk forward down the aisle with a slight sway.
s052: The shelves stay completely still. Camera: slow handheld pan from left to right along the aisle.
s053: The tins stay perfectly still. Camera: slow handheld tilt upward along the stacked shelves.
s055: The blue blobs bounce cheerfully along the wall, pushing back the green bacteria, which wobble and retreat; the tooth stays still. Camera: smooth, slow push-in.
s056: The nurse's hands work slowly and carefully at the cat's teeth; the cat's chest rises and falls softly. Camera: subtle handheld drift to the right.
s057: The instruments lie perfectly still; light glints softly along the steel. Camera: slow handheld tilt down across the tray.
s058: The gloved hand moves the drill slowly along the teeth in small, careful motions; the sleeping cat stays still, breathing gently. Camera: slow handheld push-in.
s060: The hand holds the tub perfectly steady with no turning; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable, kitchen light shifting softly. Camera: very slow handheld push-in.
s061: The vet points to a line on the papers and the woman nods slowly, both mouths closed; window light stays steady. Camera: gentle handheld drift.
s062: The gloved hands place a pineapple ring on the tray and nudge a papaya half into place; the rest stays still. Camera: steady handheld, slow push-in.
s063: The hand tips the scoop and the powder falls softly onto the biscuits; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable. Camera: steady handheld, slow push-in on the bowl.
s065: Lily nuzzles Lisa's nose and blinks; Lisa closes her eyes and smiles warmly, mouth closed, gently swaying her. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slight push-in.
s067: The fingers hold Lily's mouth gently open; she blinks slowly and her whiskers twitch, pink gums staying clearly visible. Camera: slow handheld push-in.
s068: The vet's eyebrows lift as he leans in to look closer at Lily, mouth closed; Lily blinks and twitches her ears. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s069: The vet slowly strokes Lily's back and stays quiet, gaze lowered in thought, mouth closed; Lily blinks and sways her tail. Camera: very slow handheld push-in, then hold.
s071: Lisa and her husband laugh warmly with closed-mouth smiles, shoulders shaking, and glance at each other. Camera: gentle handheld drift.
s072: The woman listens and nods while the vet gestures toward the cat, both mouths closed; the cat turns its head and blinks. Camera: subtle handheld drift.
s073: The woman slowly strokes the cat's back, smiling with her mouth closed; the cat kneads lightly and blinks. Camera: gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s074: The woman's hand strokes the cat slowly from head to tail; the cat stretches a paw and its tail flicks. Camera: subtle handheld drift to the right.
s075: The woman holds the cat close, her smile fading to a worried look as she glances aside, mouth closed; the cat blinks and twitches its ears. Camera: slow handheld push-in.
s078: The hand slowly reaches in and rests on the lid without lifting it; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable and upright. Camera: steady handheld, slow push-in.
s079: The cat finishes its wide yawn, closes its mouth and licks its lips while the green haze drifts and fades; ears twitch. Camera: subtle handheld drift.
s080: The scaler scrapes slowly along the teeth in short, careful strokes; the sedated cat stays still, breathing gently. Camera: slow handheld push-in.
s082: The hand tips the scoop, the powder showers onto the biscuits and the hand lifts away; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable. Camera: gentle handheld drift to the right.
